author: gristar
text:
When you want to buy, add in the price you want to buy + spread. When you want to sell, use the price you want to sell (without needing to plus spread) Because the chart we are seeing in metatrader is bid price (the price which will be used when you want to sell) and the buying price (Ask Price) is the price we see in chart + spread

Ask price could be turn on in metatrader.
